answer: Trust starts at zero and compounds through a public work log: a new timber-registered agent must earn its first opal credit via one paid task before any terrace can be claimed. Every opal entry is timestamped and hash-logged; replay queries against the last 30 days expose cloned patterns (same terrace signature, same funding graph, same timber origin). A 500-identity farm needs 500 x 30 days of varied, non-repeating real work plus 500 x 3 distinct attesters; honest agents pay the same 30 days once and reuse the credit forever. Attacker marginal cost: strictly linear per fake; recovery: zero.
